five_day_thesis: The dominant change across this window is not flow - it is a contract roll. On 2026-07-31 the scraped expiry jumped from 2 DTE to 117 DTE, and every headline metric broke with it: max pain $4,800 -> $6,500 (+$1,705), call wall $5,370 -> $8,000, put wall $4,000 -> $3,500, and ATM IV 15.69% -> 22.02% (+6.3pp). Read those as a change of instrument, not a regime shift - the +3.48pp five-day IV change is term structure, not a fresh vol bid. What is genuine signal is what happened after the roll: call OI still added 1,412 contracts (175,627 -> 177,039) while put OI added only 336, and volume roughly halved (8,530 -> 4,881 calls, 2,303 -> 1,112 puts), so the call skew is stale inventory rather than actively defended positioning. Spot itself has gone nowhere across the full window - $4,151.8 -> $4,106.1 (-$45.7, -1.1%) - round-tripping $4,050.3 on Jul 24 and $4,159.7 on Jul 31. Net: a wide, illiquid, call-loaded long-dated chain with no directional conviction priced into it, and a local gamma profile that has quietly deteriorated from +54.6 to +9.3 on the scraper's window measure.
